name: Agency Maintenance Activity Reports
author: Romell Ulgasan

sections.description:
Agency Maintenance Activity Reports helps WordPress agencies and freelancers document maintenance work and send professional reports to clients.

Install it on client websites to automatically log WordPress core, plugin, and theme activity, add manual maintenance notes, and generate HTML reports that can be previewed, printed, or emailed.

Learn more at pinoydev.com.

Features

  • Automatic activity logging for WordPress core, plugin, and theme updates
  • Logs plugin activations and deactivations
  • Manual maintenance notes for work that is not captured automatically
  • Branded HTML report preview and email delivery
  • Agency logo, brand color, custom intro/footer, and email subject
  • Option to hide vendor branding on client reports
  • Activity dashboard and log
  • Agency and client settings

Important

This plugin logs activity from the point it is activated forward. It does not retroactively import historical update logs from before installation.

Always review a report preview before emailing it to a client.

Support

For direct support, contact support@pinoydev.com.

For community support, use the plugin support forum on WordPress.org.

For product information, visit pinoydev.com.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the agency-maintenance-activity-reports folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Maintenance → Settings and configure your agency name, branding, and client email.
  4. Go to Maintenance → Generate Report to preview or email a report.
sections.faq:
Is this the same as WP Client Reports?

No. Agency Maintenance Activity Reports is an independent plugin with slug agency-maintenance-activity-reports. It is not affiliated with other client reporting plugins.

Does this plugin call external servers?

No. This plugin stores activity on your WordPress site and does not send site data to third-party servers.

Can I customize report branding?

Yes. You can upload an agency logo, set a brand color, customize the report intro and footer, change the email subject, and hide vendor branding on client reports.

Where can I get support?

Use the WordPress.org support forum for this plugin, or email support@pinoydev.com.
